name: Linear Hashed Marching Cubes
definition: A loose implementation of 'Fast Generation of Pointerless Octree Duals' that uses marching cubes over a linear hashed octree for faster performance.
summary: Linear Hashed Marching Cubes is a high-performance surface extraction method that generates meshes from implicit volumes using a pointerless, hash-based octree to reduce memory overhead and traversal time.
